bioconda.name: bioconductor-uniprot.ws
bioconda.summary: R Interface to UniProt Web Services

biotools.summary: The Universal Protein Resource (UniProt) is a comprehensive resource for protein sequence and annotation data. This package provides a collection of functions for retrieving, processing, and re-packaging UniProt web services. The package makes use of UniProt's modernized REST API and allows mapping of identifiers accross different databases.
